item.title: What Are Essential Oils? A Complete Guide on Aromatherapy and Its Potential Health Benefits
item.description: Discover the potential health benefits of essential oils, including reduced anxiety and improved sleep, and their side effects, recommended usages, and other safety tips.

item.title: Crohn’s Disease and Osteoporosis: What’s the Connection?
item.description: Crohn’s, a form of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), is associated with a higher risk of bone density loss and even osteoporosis. Find out why.

item.title: Ulcerative Colitis: Know Your Workplace Rights
item.description: UC symptoms can affect your ability to work, but there are legal protections that allow you to ask for reasonable accommodations to do your job, or to take medical leave.

item.title: Can Prebiotics Help Treat IBD? Navigating the Research and Food Choices
item.description: Find out how prebiotic foods can support gut health and potentially alleviate inflammatory bowel disease symptoms, and learn what research suggests about potential benefits and risks.

item.title: Is the Cabbage Soup Diet Safe or Healthy?
item.description: The cabbage soup diet is a type of fad diet that aims to help you lose weight fast. But is it healthy or even safe? Get details here.

item.title: 9 Ways to Make Your Oatmeal With More Protein
item.description: Learn how to make a protein-packed oatmeal breakfast with these quick and easy tips from nutrition experts.

item.title: How Cognitive Dissonance Shows Up in Our Relationships
item.description: Too much unresolved cognitive dissonance can be a problem. Learn how it affects all types of relationships, from friendships to marriage.

item.title: Statin Side Effect Risks May Be Much Lower Than You Think
item.description: In a new research review, this common cholesterol-lowering medication does not cause the majority of side effects listed on the packaging.

item.title: Hims & Hers to Offer a Cheaper Knockoff Version of the Wegovy Pill
item.description: At a starting cost of just $49 per month, the new pills are the cheapest GLP-1 option yet. But experts say compounded drugs like this one pose risks.

item.title: 7 Reasons to See a Sleep Doctor (Somnologist)
item.description: If you struggle with snoring, constant fatigue, or nighttime restlessness, it may be time to see a somnologist, who can diagnose and treat sleep disorders.
